$comment: Catalog of what scdemos/demo already provides. The customer-demo skill maps customer components onto these before writing any new code. Keep in sync when blocks/variants/section styles change.

brandSlots.$comment: Blocks reference these palette tokens directly (~250 refs). Re-theming = re-assigning these values inside the BRAND TOKENS block at the top of styles/styles.css. Do not rename them.

colors.--color-rust: primary brand color (buttons, rust sections, links on hover)
colors.--color-parchment: light page background + light text on dark

typography.--font-family: body font stack (declared in styles/fonts.css, file in /fonts)

extraTokens.--footer-logo-filter: e.g. brightness(0) invert(1) when a dark raster logo sits on the dark footer

brandSlots.rgbLiterals: ~87 rgb(161 79 43 / x%), rgb(197 160 89 / x%), rgb(209 106 62 / x%), rgb(245 242 237 / x%), rgb(6 13 13 / x%), rgb(22 33 33 / x%) tints in blocks/styles: remap mechanically to the new brand rgb values.

sectionStyles.$comment: Applied with a Section Metadata block, key 'style'.

hero.use: page-top banner. banner = full-bleed photo, dark scrim, white sans text (corporate/FS sites); default = faded heritage hero

cards.use: text = text-only tiles with arrow links (capabilities, news); list = rows with date/title/byline + thumbnail right (insights); stats = big figures + label (AUM, headcount); default = image + body grid; bento = mosaic

teaser.use: single promo: image + heading + copy + CTA

faq.use: INDEX-DRIVEN: rows are category names, Q&A come from /faq-index.json. For authored Q&A use tabs instead.

related-articles.use: auto list of articles/insights from query-index

product-grid.use: grid driven by a JSON index (products, funds, strategies)

journey-map.use: GATED step-by-step checklist ("complete each checkpoint to unlock"). Not a timeline: use table striped (Year | Milestone) for history.

compound-interest-calculator.use: financial calculator; currency/locale from metadata (currency, locale)

form.use: spreadsheet-driven form: row 1 = link to /forms/<name>.json (field,type,label,options,required,...), row 2 = submit URL (https://demo.bbird.live/contact-us/ allows any origin)

n8n-form.use: form posting to an n8n webhook (contact / subscribe)

features.experimentation: plugins/experimentation: experiments, audiences, campaigns + sidekick overlay
features.martech: plugins/martech: Adobe Web SDK (alloy), Target offers incl. section-level decision scopes
features.cloneit: tools/cloneit: repoless clone of a DA template site
features.queryIndex: query.yaml (site config) feeding related-articles, search, product-grid

mappingRules: Fidelity first: never force a customer pattern into a block if it changes the look; never drop content.

Pick the lowest level that reproduces the pattern faithfully: 0 default content, 1 existing block, 2 section style, 3 CSS-only variant, 4 variant with JS, 5 new block, 6 header/footer chrome variant via site metadata, 7 template, 8 global feature/plugin.
New block when the content model, interaction or over ~40% of the CSS differs; otherwise a variant.
Name everything generically; record level, content model and baseCandidate in this manifest.

pageMetadata.social-share: off hides the floating share dock (delayed.js)
pageMetadata.currency: ISO code for calculators (USD, TWD, CAD…)
pageMetadata.Experiment / Experiment Variants: page-level A/B: variants are full pages, relative paths OK
pageMetadata.Campaign-<name>: value must be the served URL of the campaign page: a DA doc named index is served at the FOLDER url (/campaigns/x/), not /campaigns/x/index
